metaDescription: Ahrefs is an SEO platform for keyword research, backlink analysis, rank tracking, site audits and AI visibility. See its features, Free, Starter, Lite, Standard, Advanced and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Ahrefs is an SEO platform for keyword research, backlink analysis, competitor research, rank tracking and technical site audits. It's powered by its own web crawler and more than 16 years of web-scale data.

Ahrefs also tracks visibility in AI search, with Brand Radar and AI prompt tracking for tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews. A free account covers site audits, backlinks and basic rankings for websites you verify you own. Paid plans unlock competitor research and more data, from a $29 Starter plan up to Enterprise.

features.title: Site Explorer
features.text: Analyse any website's backlinks, organic traffic and top pages.

features.title: Keywords Explorer
features.text: Research keywords with search volumes, difficulty and ideas.

features.title: Site Audit
features.text: Crawl your site to find technical SEO issues, free for verified sites.

features.title: Rank Tracker
features.text: Track your keyword rankings over time.

features.title: AI visibility
features.text: Track how your brand appears in AI search with Brand Radar and prompt tracking.

features.title: API and MCP
features.text: Access Ahrefs data through an API and MCP, included from the Lite plan.

strengths: Large backlink and keyword datasets from its own crawler.
A free account for site owners, with site audits and backlinks.
AI search visibility tracking alongside classic SEO.
limitations: The free account only works for sites you verify you own.
Starter is limited to 200 credits a month and one month of history.
Paid plans use credits, and reports draw them down as you work.
Extra users cost more, and Starter can't add users or credits.
Plans above Starter range from $129 to $1,499 a month.

pricing.summary: Free account for verified sites. Starter is billed monthly only; for annual billing on other plans, contact Ahrefs support. Ahrefs says it never runs discounts and doesn't list a free trial.
